about: A JavaScript library for reading, formatting and doing math with dates and times.

prs.title: Day and week counts are right across a clock change
prs.broken: Counting the days or weeks between two dates came out one short when the range crossed the start of summer time, because that day is only 23 hours.
prs.changed: I made the count make up for the clock change before dividing into days and weeks.
prs.matters: Booking lengths, countdowns and due dates in spring are no longer off by a day.

prs.title: Month names in Russian, Polish and Korean dates read correctly
prs.broken: Reading a date like "9 января 2026" gave the current month instead of January, and an unknown month name gave no error at all.
prs.changed: I made the reader try both forms of each month name and raise an error when neither matches.
prs.matters: Dates the library writes itself can be read back, in many languages.
